newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Aeroflot to acquire new Tupolevs.
newsitem.headline: Aeroflot to acquire new Tupolevs.

text.p: Russian flagship carrier Aeroflot plans to acquire new medium-range Tupolev Tu-204 and Tupolev Tu-214 passenger aircraft, the company said on Thursday.
A statement quoting Aeroflot chief executive Valery Okulov said the Russian-made aircraft would go into service "soon".

Okulov said last week: "We have had offers from Boeing Co and other Western plane-makers to expand Aeroflot's fleet and we are considering them. But first we are studying the possiblity of operating Russian-made planes."
Okulov said Russian airlines were very interested in operating Tu-204s and Tu-214s.
It was not clear if Aeroflot would buy or lease the new planes or how many aircraft would be involved.
